Messages.Author: Lrayox
Messages.Body:
The Trap card reads "Combat automatically has a press, usable to continue
combat each round.  This continues until 3 rounds of combat pass with no
cards being played by any Methuselah. Only usable before is determined on
the first round."

Does the second sentence mean that a) you can play other cards until you
chose not to, then three rounds must pass without Methuselahs playing
cards, or b)three rounds must be played without additional cards being
played? 
Please e-mail responce or post it.  Thanking you in advance. 

Lrayox

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Lrayox <lrayox@aol.com> wrote:
>The Trap card reads...
>Does the second sentence mean that a) you can play other cards until you
>chose not to, then three rounds must pass without Methuselahs playing cards
>or b)three rounds must be played without additional cards being played? 

It means that during the combat in which Trap was used, each round has an
automatic press to continue if any card (including Trap) has been played
within the last three rounds.

Messages.Author: Jinx M.
Messages.Body:
Re: Re: Jyhad , Question about "Trap"
 
> I'm sorry, but still confused. First, assume I don't have a press card,
> my prey play it when I am sucessfully blocking his bleed.
> what's going on: (without consider of ALL the press:continue/end combat cards
>  The combat won't be end until:
>  1) three rounds pass with no new card played after "trap".
>  2) any single card had play after the third round.
>  3) The third round count from the latest card being played.
> which one??????????????

(1), I think, but you're message is weird.   You have to have THREE rounds
with NO CARDS PLAYED, and then there is no press from Trap in that last
round, so it'll end then.  Since playing Trap counts as playing a card, the
round that it's played won't count as one of those three rounds.  Oh, and the
rounds have to be CONSECUTIVE.
